# Personal Blog Implementation Plan

**Goal:** Stand up a Hugo + PaperMod personal blog (About / Projects / Contributions / Posts / Research / Tags) running on `localhost`, with light/dark/system theme toggle, search, KaTeX, Mermaid, and a polished About homepage. No public deploy in v1.

**Architecture:** Static site generated by Hugo. PaperMod theme as a git submodule. Site config in `hugo.toml`. Content in markdown under `content/`. Custom layout overrides in `layouts/` for the homepage and project/contribution pages. Small CSS overlay in `assets/css/extended/`.

**Tech stack:** Hugo extended (pinned), PaperMod theme (git submodule), KaTeX (per-page), Mermaid (per-page), Fuse.js (PaperMod built-in).

**Mode:** Direct execution by Claude. The user reviews each task's diff and commits it themselves.

---

## End-user mental model

- **Reader** (recruiter, peer, stranger) → opens `localhost:1313` → sees About → scans nav → reads Posts/Research/Projects/Contributions.
- **Author** (you) → writes a markdown file → `hugo server -D` → checks locally → flips `draft: false` → commits.
- **No login.** No backend. No database. The "admin" is whoever has push access to the git repo.

---

## System map

```
                                hugo.toml (config)
                                       │
                ┌──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
                │                      │                      │
        themes/PaperMod/        layouts/ (overrides)    assets/css/extended/
        (vendored, untouched)            │                  custom.css
                                         │
                ┌──────────────┬─────────┴─────────┬──────────────────┐
                │              │                   │                  │
        layouts/index.html  layouts/projects/ layouts/contributions/  layouts/404.html
        (About homepage)    list.html         list.html               (custom 404)
                │              │                   │
                ▼              ▼                   ▼
                          content/
                ┌──────────────┬───────────────┬───────────────┬────────────────┐
                │              │               │               │                │
        content/_index.md  content/posts/ content/projects/ content/research/ content/contributions/
        (About copy)      (page bundles)  (_index.md +     (page bundles)    (_index.md only)
                                          card data)
```

**Data flow:** markdown frontmatter → Hugo build → static HTML in `public/` → `hugo server` serves it.
**Dependency direction:** `layouts/` overrides `themes/PaperMod/layouts/`. `assets/css/extended/*.css` is appended to the theme stylesheet.

---

## File layout (final)

```
.
├── .gitignore                          # Hugo build artifacts
├── .hugo-version                       # pinned Hugo version string
├── README.md                           # how to run, write, publish
├── hugo.toml                           # site config + PaperMod params + menu
├── docs/
│   ├── SPEC.md                         # exists
│   └── PLAN.md                         # this file
├── archetypes/
│   └── default.md                      # frontmatter template for `hugo new`
├── themes/
│   └── PaperMod/                       # git submodule (read-only)
├── assets/
│   └── css/
│       └── extended/
│           └── custom.css              # small typography/spacing overrides
├── layouts/
│   ├── index.html                      # About homepage override
│   ├── 404.html                        # custom 404
│   ├── projects/
│   │   └── list.html                   # card-grid override
│   └── contributions/
│       └── list.html                   # contributions list override
├── static/
│   └── images/
│       └── avatar.png                  # placeholder; user replaces later
└── content/
    ├── _index.md                       # About / homepage copy
    ├── search.md                       # enables PaperMod search page
    ├── posts/
    │   └── hello-world/
    │       ├── index.md                # seed post (math + mermaid + code)
    │       └── (any images)
    ├── projects/
    │   └── _index.md                   # title + intro + projects list (frontmatter array)
    ├── research/
    │   └── why-static-sites/
    │       └── index.md                # seed research entry
    └── contributions/
        └── _index.md                   # title + intro + contributions list (frontmatter array)
```

**Single responsibility per file** — each layout file owns exactly one page type; `custom.css` only carries overrides; `_index.md` files own only their section's copy and (where listed) structured data.

## Conventions used by every task

### Frontmatter contract (all posts and research entries)

```yaml
---
title: "Example title"
date: 2026-05-10
draft: false
tags: ["tag-a", "tag-b"]
math: false
mermaid: false
summary: "1-line summary used on lists and OG cards."
---
```

- `math: true` → page loads KaTeX (gated in a partial, see Task 7).
- `mermaid: true` → page loads Mermaid (gated in a partial, see Task 7).
- `draft: true` → excluded from build unless `hugo server -D`.

### Pinned versions (use these exact values)

- Hugo extended: **0.139.4** (latest stable as of plan-writing; Claude may bump to a newer 0.139.x patch but must not change minor).
- PaperMod theme submodule: track branch **master**, pin to commit at submodule add time.

### Config format

`hugo.toml` (TOML), not `hugo.yaml`. PaperMod's docs use YAML samples — Claude must translate them to TOML.

### Verification command (most tasks)

`hugo --gc --minify` from the repo root → must exit 0. For visual checks, `hugo server -D` then open `http://localhost:1313/<path>`.

### Task 4: Full hugo.toml configuration

**Delivers:** SPEC §3 (config), §4 (theme toggle, header), §6 (features).

**Files**
- Modify: `hugo.toml` (replace stub from Task 2 with full config).

**Implementation**

Translate the YAML reference from PaperMod docs into TOML. Required keys:

- `baseURL = "http://localhost:1313/"`
- `languageCode = "en-us"`
- `title = "Personal Blog"` (Claude: pick this exact string; user can rename later)
- `theme = "PaperMod"`
- `pagination.pagerSize = 10`
- `enableRobotsTXT = true`
- `buildDrafts = false`, `buildFuture = false`, `buildExpired = false`
- `[minify]` → `disableXML = true`, `minifyOutput = true`
- `pygmentsUseClasses = true`
- `[markup.highlight]` → `noClasses = false`, `style = "github"` (light) — dark variant handled by PaperMod via classes
- `[markup.goldmark.renderer]` → `unsafe = true` (required for KaTeX/Mermaid raw HTML in markdown)

Under `[params]`:
- `env = "production"`
- `description = "Personal site of <Author> — projects, posts, research, contributions."`
- `author = "Author"` (placeholder — user edits)
- `defaultTheme = "auto"` (follow system)
- `disableThemeToggle = false`
- `ShowReadingTime = true`
- `ShowShareButtons = false`
- `ShowPostNavLinks = true`
- `ShowBreadCrumbs = false`
- `ShowCodeCopyButtons = true`
- `ShowWordCount = false`
- `ShowToc = false`
- `comments = false`
- `profileMode.enabled = false` (we use a custom homepage layout, not profileMode)

Under `[params.fuseOpts]`:
- `isCaseSensitive = false`, `shouldSort = true`, `location = 0`, `distance = 1000`, `threshold = 0.4`, `minMatchCharLength = 0`, `limit = 10`, `keys = ["title", "permalink", "summary", "content"]`.

Under `[[params.socialIcons]]` (one TOML table per icon, in this order):
- `{ name = "github", url = "https://github.com/<USER>" }`
- `{ name = "linkedin", url = "https://linkedin.com/in/<USER>" }`
- `{ name = "x", url = "https://x.com/<USER>" }`
- `{ name = "email", url = "mailto:<USER>@example.com" }`

(Use literal `<USER>` placeholders — user fills in.)

Under `[[menu.main]]`, in this exact order (weight ascending):
| identifier | name | url | weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| about | About | / | 10 |
| projects | Projects | /projects/ | 20 |
| contributions | Contributions | /contributions/ | 30 |
| posts | Posts | /posts/ | 40 |
| research | Research | /research/ | 50 |
| tags | Tags | /tags/ | 60 |
| search | Search | /search/ | 70 |

Under `[outputs]`: `home = ["HTML", "RSS", "JSON"]` — JSON is required for Fuse.js search index.

**Verify**
Run: `hugo --quiet --gc`
Expected: exit 0. `public/index.html` exists and `<title>` contains "Personal Blog". `public/index.json` exists.

**Commit message**
`feat: configure hugo site, theme params, and menu`

### Task 6: Custom homepage (About) layout

**Delivers:** SPEC §4 (About page layout).

**Files**
- Create: `layouts/index.html`.
- Create: `layouts/partials/about-header.html` (avatar + intro + social icons fragment).

**Implementation**

`layouts/index.html` must:
1. Extend the theme's baseof: `{{- define "main" -}} … {{- end -}}` and use the PaperMod base template (`{{- partial "head.html" . -}}` etc. — follow PaperMod's conventions; reference `themes/PaperMod/layouts/_default/single.html` for the structure).
2. Render, in this order inside `<main class="main">`:
   - `{{ partial "about-header.html" . }}`
   - The page Content (`{{ .Content }}`) — the markdown body of `content/_index.md`.
   - A "Latest posts" `<section>` listing the 5 most recent pages from the `posts` section (`where site.RegularPages "Section" "posts"`, sorted by date desc, limited to 5). For each: link to permalink, title, date (formatted via site `DateFormat`), reading time, summary. Reuse PaperMod's existing list-item styles by mirroring the markup PaperMod uses in `themes/PaperMod/layouts/_default/list.html`.

`layouts/partials/about-header.html` must render:
- A flex container, mobile-first (`display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem;` desktop becomes row via media query in `custom.css`).
- Left column: a circular `<img>` for the avatar.
  - `src = "/images/avatar.png"`, `alt = site.Params.author`, `width = 120`, `height = 120`, `loading = "eager"`.
  - Class `avatar-circle` (styled in `custom.css`).
  - If `/images/avatar.png` is missing at build time, render an empty `<div class="avatar-circle avatar-placeholder" aria-label="Avatar placeholder"></div>` instead.
  - Use Hugo's `resources.Get` to detect file presence: `{{ with resources.Get "images/avatar.png" }} … {{ else }} … {{ end }}`.
- Right column: `<h1>` site title, `<p class="tagline">` reading from `.Params.tagline` (fall back to site `.Params.description`), and a `<ul class="social-icons">` rendering each `socialIcons` entry using PaperMod's existing `partial "social_icons.html"` if it accepts data, otherwise inline the icon markup.

**Test contract** (manual visual; covered in Task 12 verification):
- On desktop (≥768px), avatar is left, text right, both vertically centered.
- On mobile, avatar stacks above text.
- Latest-posts section shows up to 5 entries, no duplicates with drafts excluded.
- If `static/images/avatar.png` is absent, a circular gray placeholder appears (no broken image icon).

**Verify**
Run: `hugo server -D` then `curl -s http://localhost:1313/ | grep -E '(avatar-circle|Latest)'`
Expected: both grep matches return at least one line each. Stop the server.

**Commit message**
`feat: custom about homepage layout with avatar and latest posts`

### Task 7: KaTeX and Mermaid opt-in partials

**Delivers:** SPEC §3 (math, diagrams), §6.

**Files**
- Create: `layouts/partials/extend_head.html`.
- Create: `layouts/partials/extend_footer.html`.

**Implementation**

PaperMod automatically calls `partials/extend_head.html` and `partials/extend_footer.html` if they exist in the site's `layouts/partials/`. Use them to inject KaTeX and Mermaid CDN assets only when the page opts in.

`layouts/partials/extend_head.html`:
- If `.Params.math` is truthy AND the page kind is `page` or `home` or `section`:
  - Inject `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.css" integrity="sha384-nB0miv6/jRmo5UMMR1wu3Gz6NLsoTkbqJghGIsx//Rlm+ZU03BU6SQNC66uf4l5+" crossorigin="anonymous">`.
- No other content.

`layouts/partials/extend_footer.html`:
- If `.Params.math` is truthy:
  - Inject KaTeX JS + auto-render JS: `<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.js" integrity="sha384-7zkQWkzuo3B5mTepMUcHkMB5jZaolc2xDwL6VFqjFALcbeS9Ggm/Yr2r3Dy4lfFg" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>` and `<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js" integrity="sha384-43gviWU0YVjaDtb/GhzOouOXtZMP/7XUzwPTstBeZFe/+rCMvRwr4yROQP43s0Xk" crossorigin="anonymous" onload="renderMathInElement(document.body, {delimiters: [{left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true}, {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}]});"></script>`.
- If `.Params.mermaid` is truthy:
  - Inject `<script type="module">import mermaid from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.4.1/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs'; mermaid.initialize({startOnLoad: false}); document.querySelectorAll('pre > code.language-mermaid').forEach((el, i) => { const id = 'mermaid-' + i; const div = document.createElement('div'); div.id = id; div.className = 'mermaid'; div.textContent = el.textContent; el.parentElement.replaceWith(div); }); mermaid.run();</script>`.
- Both scripts are skipped entirely when their flags are false → zero JS impact on pages that don't need it.

**Test contract**
- On `/posts/hello-world/`, both KaTeX CSS and Mermaid script are present in the rendered HTML.
- On `/`, neither KaTeX nor Mermaid assets are loaded (About has `math: false`, `mermaid: false` by default — verify by NOT setting those params in `_index.md`).
- Math expressions render (visible check during Task 12).
- Mermaid `graph TD` renders as SVG (visible check during Task 12).

**Verify**
Run:
```
hugo --quiet --gc && grep -l "katex" public/posts/hello-world/index.html && grep -L "katex" public/index.html
```
Expected: both grep checks return their target file paths (KaTeX present in post, absent on homepage).

**Commit message**
`feat: opt-in katex and mermaid via extend_head/footer partials`

### Task 11: CSS overrides

**Delivers:** SPEC §4 (design polish), §10 (failure-mode mitigation).

**Files**
- Create: `assets/css/extended/custom.css`.

**Implementation**

Single CSS file with these rules only (no other concerns):

1. `.avatar-circle` — `width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;`.
2. `.avatar-placeholder` — `background: var(--tertiary); border-radius: 50%;`.
3. About-header layout — flex column on mobile, flex row with `align-items: center; gap: 2rem;` at min-width 768px.
4. `.project-card` — `border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--entry);`.
5. Projects grid — `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem;` with `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);` at min-width 768px.
6. `.contribution-list .date` — `color: var(--secondary); font-size: 0.85em; margin-left: 0.5em;`.
7. `.tagline` — `color: var(--secondary); margin-top: -0.25rem;`.
8. Generous body line-height tweak: `.post-content { line-height: 1.7; }`.

Reference: PaperMod auto-bundles every `.css` file under `assets/css/extended/`, so the file just needs to exist at this path.

**Verify**
Run: `hugo --quiet --gc && grep -l "avatar-circle" public/assets/css/*.css` (path may differ — adjust to the bundled stylesheet PaperMod produces; the test is that the rule is present in some bundled CSS file under `public/`).
Expected: grep matches.

## Glossary

- **Hugo** — static site generator written in Go. Reads markdown + templates → outputs HTML.
- **SSG (static site generator)** — tool that converts content files into plain HTML at build time. No backend at runtime.
- **PaperMod** — popular Hugo theme. Used by Lilian Weng's site.
- **Page bundle** — a folder containing `index.md` plus assets, treated by Hugo as one page. Lets you keep images alongside the post that uses them.
- **Frontmatter** — YAML/TOML block at the top of a markdown file with metadata (title, date, tags, etc.).
- **Submodule** — a git repo nested inside another repo, pinned to a specific commit. Used here so PaperMod updates stay explicit.
- **Goldmark** — Hugo's default markdown parser. Compatible with GitHub Flavored Markdown.
- **Chroma** — Hugo's built-in syntax highlighter. Runs at build time, outputs colored HTML — no JS needed.
- **KaTeX** — fast LaTeX math rendering library. Used here only on pages with `math: true`.
- **Mermaid** — JS library that renders text definitions as flowcharts/diagrams. Used here only on pages with `mermaid: true`.
- **Fuse.js** — client-side fuzzy search library. PaperMod ships search built on it.
- **Lighthouse** — Chrome DevTools audit tool. Scores Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO.
